title: Establish golden-response dataset and hit-conditioned regression eval for prefix/KV cache
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a reproducible, hit-conditioned evaluation harness and a "golden" response dataset for prefix/KV cache correctness. The goal is to detect and triage regressions that occur only when cached prefixes are served (cache-hit cases) vs cache-miss paths. This ticket covers dataset curation, metrics design, local replay harness, CI gating rules, and alerting playbook.
background: Recent model/config rollouts and runtime kernel changes have produced low-rate behavioural diffs that surface only when a request hits the KV/prefix cache. Existing evals focus on global output diffs and miss hit-conditioned sensitivity. We need a targeted approach to reliably reproduce and triage cache-hit-only regressions across model versions and quantization configs.
proposed_solution: 1) Curate a golden-response set (golden_set_v1.jsonl) capturing paired (prompt, canonical_response) for high-value workloads and edge cases. 2) Instrument the runtime to tag each request record with hit metadata (hit_type, kv_key_signature, hit_position, token_span) and persist these with response snapshots. 3) Build a hit-conditioned replay harness that can force cache-hit/miss during local replay and compute a set of hit-diff metrics (hit_diff_rate, normalized_edit_distance_on_hit, structured_diff_score). 4) Add CI gating: any model/config change with runtime-1.20 that increases hit_diff_rate > 0.3% for golden set triggers CI failure and creates an issue. 5) Wire alerting to SLO dashboard + Slack channel with reproducible replay link and initial triage checklist.
acceptance_criteria: A stable golden set of at least 2k prompt-response pairs uploaded to s3://redwood-evals/golden/prefix/golden_v1.jsonl
Runtime emits hit metadata for >=99% of prefix-cache responses in test cluster (fields: hit_type, kv_signature, hit_pos, hit_tokens)
Replay harness can reliably reproduce both hit and miss paths locally and in CI (documented commands and Docker image)
Metrics implemented: hit_diff_rate, hit_edit_distance_p50/p90, structured_output_regression_count with baselines for current main models
CI gating rule added: PRs that change compilation/kernels/quantization fail if hit_diff_rate increases above threshold on golden set
Alerting runbook with rollback playbook and initial triage owner assigned is documented and tested in staging
test_plan: Create unit tests for fingerprinting logic (normalize whitespace, remove non-deterministic tokens, canonicalize JSON outputs)
End-to-end test: run harness with cached-path enabled and disabled, assert deterministic reproduction of observed drift from production trace
Synthetic adversarial prompts added to golden set to exercise boundary tokenization and KV boundary collisions
Run full golden-set eval on CI against model-branch and baseline and assert metrics reported to dashboard
Manual verification: 3 engineering reviewers to confirm reproducibility on different GPUs (A100, H100)
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (staging): instrument runtime and record hit metadata for 2 weeks; collect candidate golden responses from production traces (low sampling rate)
Phase 2 (golden set v1): curate and review 2k examples, run initial hit-conditioned eval across models in staging
Phase 3 (CI integration): add gating to PR pipeline for runtime and inference-related repos; run daily batch checks and fail-on-regressions
Phase 4 (production): enable alerting and create automated issue + Slack summary on threshold breach; iterate on thresholds after 2 weeks
monitoring_and_alerting: Add hit_diff_rate metric to Console under runtime > cache-correctness with daily and 1h views
Alert: hit_diff_rate increase > 0.5% absolute over baseline for 1h -> Pager to on-call and create issue in linear with reproducible replay link
Low-severity alert: weekly trend > 0.2% -> notify eng-runtime channel with attached CSV of diffs
Dashboard widgets: per-model, per-quantization-profile, per-region breakdown and top 10 prompts by diff contribution
implementation_notes: Fingerprinting: use normalized token-level hash + structure-aware comparator for JSON outputs to avoid false positives from whitespace/ordering
Hit metadata fields: hit_type (PREFIX|KV|MISS), kv_signature (sha1 hex), hit_pos (start_token_index), hit_tokens_count
Replay harness should support: --force-hit, --force-miss, --seed, --kv-store-snapshot to reproduce warm-path state
Storage: golden_set_v1.jsonl lines contain: prompt_id, prompt_text, canonical_response, expected_fingerprint, tags
Performance: ensure instrumentation adds <1% p50 latency overhead in staging; fall back to sampling if overhead is higher
